correctness.rationale: Full all-n proof: cyclic incidence matrices classify all facets; exact recurrence and discrete Laplacian calculate normalized facet normals; rotational averaging proves global optimality; tangent normal balance and bipartite graph equations determine all optimal centers, with every nontangent inequality retained in the explicit difference polytope. Rational-arithmetic 1022 exact checks for 3<=n<=26 corroborate but do not prove the infinite case. The computed eigenvalue, resistance, and coefficient-map identities have explicit elementary proofs in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: Intrinsic Euclidean roundness of the basic cycle-selected subconfiguration of regular-simplex edge midpoints is motivated by contemporary midpoint extremal geometry. The exact all-n facet-distance shell spectrum explains a sharp mod-four phase transition between a unique inball center and an (n/2−1)-dimensional center polytope, and gives every center by an explicit difference-constraint system. This is not a textbook-scale substitution, isolated small example, or known-table recomputation.
